scenes.headline: Long tail at support. Who won?
scenes.say: Price dropped below support and left a long tail. Who won this candle? Decide before the reveal.

scenes.headline: Long tail at support. Who won?
Long tail at support. Who won?
scenes.say: Buyers. Price dropped below support, and buyers pushed it all the way back to close near the high. The tail is about five times the body.

scenes.headline: Long tail at support. Who won?
scenes.say: A pin bar tends to mean more at a level after a pullback, like here. Many traders put the stop just below the tip of the tail: if price goes back there, the rejection failed. Follow for tomorrow's chart.
